glossary.definition: (1) "Label" means a molded imprint or raised symbol that includes a code consisting of letters and numbers and is placed on or near the bottom of a plastic bottle or rigid plastic container to indicate the plastic resin used to produce the bottle or container.
glossary.source_title: Section 3734.60 - Plastic containers labeled with code for basic material used in bottle or container.

glossary.definition: (2) "Plastic" means any material made of polymeric organic compounds and additives that can be shaped by means of the flowing of the material.
glossary.source_title: Section 3734.60 - Plastic containers labeled with code for basic material used in bottle or container.

glossary.definition: (3) "Plastic bottle" means a plastic container that has a neck that is smaller than the body of the container; that accepts a screw-type cap, snap cap, or other closure; and that has a capacity of at least sixteen ounces but less than five gallons.
glossary.source_title: Section 3734.60 - Plastic containers labeled with code for basic material used in bottle or container.
